title: Bolívar y San Martín
goal: Read about two independence campaigns converging from opposite directions, an Andes crossing that surprised the royalist army, and the 1822 Guayaquil meeting after which one man walked away from public life.

items: Explain the direction each campaign advanced from, and where they converged.
Describe what Bolívar achieved by crossing the Andes in 1819.
Explain what San Martín decided after the 1822 Guayaquil meeting and what it allowed.
Explain what Bolívar founded after Boyacá and which territory he added in 1821.
Use the gerund to describe two leaders acting in parallel.
